# Vendored from vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines

Source: https://github.com/vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines at commit `434b7f91364665f2f733b310ec54809bf8f37937` (MIT, see LICENSE).
`guidelines.md` is `command.md` copied verbatim and pinned. The upstream `web-design-guidelines` skill fetches this file from GitHub at every run; Itqan never fetches it, so the rules cannot change underneath a project.

Reading notes for Itqan: the "Review these files" line and `$ARGUMENTS` placeholder come from the upstream command format. In Itqan the rules are used as a checklist for wireframes (UX Spec) and for the built screens (Acceptance).
